2026-10-11 09:47:27.937810 | controller |
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937813 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937817 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937819 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937823 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937826 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-11 09:47:27.937829 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
